tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma 'jam dbyangs la btud de// tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs bri bar bya// de ni tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i gang zag spyi bo bde ba chen po'i gnas su dga' ba bcu drug mngon du byas pas bde ba rgyas pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa yin pa la/ zag bcas kyi bde ba la zag med kyi bde bar rlom/ de lam gong ma bsgom pa'i gags su 'gro bas/ de'i gnyen por yang dag par spong ba bzhi 'jug ste/ rags pa rgya che ba phyi rten 'brel gyi yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang*/ phra ba nang rten 'brel gyi yang dag par spong ba bzhi'o// dang po la dbang blang ba'i yul/ sprul sku las rnam par rtog pa thams cad yang dag par spong ba/ dbang rang gi ngo bo tshogs pa'i ming gis ya gyal la btags/ len mkhan gyi gang zag tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'o// dbang blang ba'i rten dge sogs pad can bcu gnyis ma las rnam par rtog pa thams cad spong bas yang dag par spong ba bzhi'o// de'ang bzhi pa rten can len pa yin te/ rig pa'i dbang re re'i gnas skabs na yang spang bya spong tshul la bsams te/ skye ba lugs byung gi dga' ba bzhi/ yon tan skye tshul la bsams te/ thim pa lugs bzlog gi dga' ba bzhi'o//

rang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs su/ rtsa g.yas kyi nus pa thams cad g.yas ro ma la bsdu/ g.yon gyi nus pa thams cad rkyang ma la bsdu/ yi ge'ang g.yas kyi bsam gtan gyi oṃ la/ g.yon gyi snying po'i a la/ khams kyang g.yas g.yon gyi nyi zla gnyis la/ rlung thams cad ldang 'jug la bsdu zhing rlung sems kyi nus pa thams cad lte ba'i gnas su 'tshogs/ de las dbu ma'i mdud pa med pa sor bzhi'i phyi logs la drod dang rtse mo/ nang logs la/ bzod pa dang chos mchog gi rtogs pa skye/ de yang lte ba'i gnas su rlung sems 'thab/ sor phyed thur du bskyod pas drod chung ngu*/ phyed du bskyod pas drod 'bring ngo*// phyed bskyod pas chen po'i drod chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas chen po drod tshad chen po'o/ spang bya bzhi cha zhi la bzhi gsum ma zhi/ kun nas nyon mongs pa la rten pa'i gzung rtog go /lam du slongs na nyan thos kyi lam chod/ gol na 'dod khams su gol/ sku bzhi las rtogs pa dang shes rab thob pas chos sku'i dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las dga' ba'i ye shes/ yang mtheb sor phyed thur du bskyod pas rtse mo chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas 'bring po/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chen po'o// spang bya gzung rtog gnyis phyed zhi la phyed ma zhi/ 'dzin rtog go /lam du slongs na rang sangs rgyas kyi lam chod/ zhen na gzugs khams su gol/ sku bzhi las longs sku'i dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las mchog dga'i ye shes/ dbu ma'i mar snar rlung sems thams cad phyin pas rtse mo chen po dngos su 'byung*/ gnas gsum shugs las 'byung ste/ nang gi sangs rgyas rnams kyi lam srid pa'i rtse mor phyin cing zhes rten pas shes gsung*/ dbu mar sems rtog med log sems 'phos pas bzod pas zhes pas bzod pa chung ngu dngos su 'byung*/ de'ang rtsa dbu ma'i nang na mar mtheb sor phyed gyen du bskyod pas bzod pa chung ngu*/

phyed bskyod pas 'bring po/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chen po'o// spang bya bzhi gsum zhi la lnga cha ma zhi/ gzung rtog gnyis dang 'dzin rtog go /lam du slongs na pha rol du phyin pa'i lam chod/ zhen na gzugs med du gol/ sku bzhi las sprul pa'i sku'i dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ 'khor ba'i chos las 'das shing*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pas chos rnams kyi mchog go /zhes pas chos mchog chen po sangs rgyas su 'byung*/ gnas gsum shugs las 'byung ste de'ang mtheb sor phyed gyen du bskyod pas chos mchog chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas 'bring po/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chen po'o// spang bya gzung 'dzin mtha' bdun spangs/ gol sa med/ gsang sngags kyi lam chod/ sku bzhi las ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las lhan skyes/ khams 'dus pa tha ma la mdor bstan pa/ sprul sku las dbang gsum gyi rjes la phyung zhing zhes pa/ dge sogs pas rgyas par bshad/ chos mchog chen po sbyar te mjug bsdu ba gsum gnyis su gsungs/ spyir lam thams cad lhag mthong zung du 'jug pa las skye zhing bye brag tu gsang sngags pas lam lus la bgrod pas gsang gnas kyi am̐ du rlung sems 'dus pa las nyer bsdogs yid la byed pa bdun gyi nyams skye ste/ de'ang mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa/ mos pa las byung zhing*/ gnas dang*/ dben pa/ dga' ba sdud pa spyod pa sa/ sbyor ba sa/ 'bras bu yid la byed pa'o// lte ba'i bsam gtan gyi aṃ du rlung sems 'dus na rtog pa med la/ spyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin/ yang tshangs ris pa sogs rten dkyil 'khor bzhi'i gnad kyis bsam gtan dang po na bzhi'o// snying gar dga' ba dang bcas shing bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin bde chen sogs bsam gtan gnyis pa na bzhi'o// mgrin par dga' ba med cing bde ba tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin/

dge ba la sogs bsam gtan gsum pa na bzhi'o// spyi bor btang snyoms yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin sprin med 'od sogs bsam gtan bzhi pa na bzhi'o// de yang dga' ba re re la bzhi bzhi yod pa dang*/ 'byung chung bcu drug gi gnad kyis gzugs med skye mched rigs bzhi la yang bcu drug tu 'gro gsung*/ mdor na bsam gtan gyi aṃ du rlung sems 'dus pa las zhi gnas skye/ snying po'i ar rlung sems 'dus pa las lhag mthong skye/ zung 'jug gi hūm̐ du rlung sems 'dus pa las/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'jug pa'i nyams snang skye'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi mngon par rtogs pa/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal pos sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
